Maya P.: pinging squad 3 final draft for the product launch post is ready here: https://g.co/ri/launch-v3. Need quick thumbs on CTAs + webinar timing.
Connor L.: skimmed. Two CTA variants ready for AB test: A="Request enterprise demo" (top rail), B="Start a free trial" (top rail). Footer keeps "Get started".
Rina S.: audience note: for APAC traffic, free trial performs better during working hours. Can we schedule publish at 09:00 PT so APAC gets evening reach?
Maya P.: proposed publish Thu 09:00 PT to balance NA morning + APAC evening. Webinar Wed 11:00 PT (live demo + live Q&A). Does that work?
Jules M.: design QA: hero crops at 360px; uploaded responsive assets and a 1x compressed SVG fallback to CMS. Also added alt text: "Diagram: request routing + cache tiers".
Sam T.: legal quick pass: remove any absolute words ("guarantee", "always"). Reword benchmark claims to be hedged and cite the internal benchmark doc. Also clear sponsor mentions.
Maya P.: updated language: "in our internal benchmarks" and added link to benchmark PDF. Removed named sponsor logos from the hero; sponsor callout moved to the bottom with partner approval note.
Connor L.: lead routing plan: hidden form fields -> deployment=Hosted|Dedicated|Private, interest=demo|trial|info. Map interest=demo -> HubSpot queue LF-5030-enterprise, trial -> nurture list. AB test id in utm_content=cta_A|cta_B.
Maya P.: adding the JS snippet to the landing page: ```window.ri_utms={utm_source:'blog',utm_medium:'organic',utm_campaign:'launch_q3',utm_content:cta_variant};```
Rina S.: thanks. Also request we include a timezone note on the webinar registration: show both PT and SGT. People in APAC need SGT on the form.
Jules M.: adjusted the registration widget to show PT & SGT. Also moved the benchmark chart next to the bullet list for better scan.
Sam T.: legal final: sponsor copy approved, benchmark phrasing acceptable with the doc link. Marked legal_approval=true in CMS.
prod-bot: :information_source: Publishing checklist: legal_approval=false, design_assets=false, cms_fields=false. Please update before scheduling.
Maya P.: updating CMS now. Design assets uploaded, legal flag set. Added HubSpot flow LF-5030 and mapping.
prod-bot: :white_check_mark: Publishing checklist: legal_approval=true, design_assets=true, cms_fields=true. You are cleared to schedule.
Connor L.: AB test setup note: we'll rotate CTA top rail daily for 7 days, collect utm_content and map to contact.property.cta_variant. After week, we'll report CTR & demo requests.
Rina S.: ops note: SDR rota assigned for demo leads: West -> LF-5030, APAC leads go to regional SDR queue. Confirmed with SDR leads.
Maya P.: final publish set Thu 09:00 PT. Webinar Thu 11:00 PT (60m setup, 15m speaker sync). I'll hit publish and drop the live URL here. Thanks for quick turn. :rocket:
